parameters.command: =VID="{{ $json.video_id }}"; URL="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${VID}"; yt-dlp --js-runtimes deno:/home/YOUR_USER/.deno/bin/deno --cookies /home/YOUR_USER/.config/yt-dlp-cookies.txt --dump-json --no-download --quiet "$URL" 2>/dev/null | head -c 200000; echo; echo "===TRANSCRIPT==="; yt-dlp --js-runtimes deno:/home/YOUR_USER/.deno/bin/deno --cookies /home/YOUR_USER/.config/yt-dlp-cookies.txt --write-auto-sub --skip-download --sub-langs en --sub-format vtt --no-write-playlist-metafiles --quiet -o "/tmp/ytw_${VID}" "$URL" 2>/dev/null; VTT=$(ls /tmp/ytw_${VID}*.vtt 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$VTT" ]; then cat "$VTT"; rm -f "$VTT"; else echo "NO_TRANSCRIPT_FOUND"; fi
